whatIs.question: What is Minaly?
whatIs.answer: Minaly is an all in one scaling coach for coaches and info businesses doing €2k to €20k per month. It combines business data, bottleneck diagnosis and a weekly action plan.

whoFor.question: Who is Minaly for?
whoFor.answer: It is built for founders and small teams who already have sales activity but need a clearer order of operations across acquisition, sales and delivery.

data.question: Which data can Minaly use?
data.answer: The core diagnosis starts with Stripe. Depending on the workflow, you can also connect iClosed or Calendly for calls, and Instagram or YouTube for content analytics.

replace.question: Does Minaly replace a business coach?
replace.answer: No. Minaly gives a coach or founder a shared operating view and a concrete next move. It supports judgment and execution rather than pretending to replace either one.

diagnostic.question: Can I start without connecting my tools?
diagnostic.answer: Yes. The free diagnostic uses a few rough figures: audience, leads, calls, sales and last month's revenue. You see your result before creating an account.

trial.question: How does the 7 day trial work?
trial.answer: Add your card to start the trial. Your subscription then renews automatically, and we send a reminder two days before the trial ends. You can cancel in one click from Settings.

finalCta.heading: Give your next growth decision a clear starting point
finalCta.description: Start with the data you already have and leave with one priority worth running this week.
finalCta.secondaryNote: One clear priority for the week, based on your business data.

metadata.title: Privacy policy | Minaly
metadata.description: How Minaly collects, uses and protects your personal data: what we collect, why we collect it, who we share it with and your GDPR rights.

privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains what data Minaly collects when you use our application, why we collect it, who we share it with and how to exercise your rights. It applies to www.minaly.io and the product application.

controller.title: 1. Who is responsible for your data
controller.body: Minaly operates the website and application available at www.minaly.io. We are the data controller for your personal data under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act. If you have a question, contact us at <email>contact@minaly.io</email>.

collectedData.title: 2. The data we collect
collectedData.intro: Depending on how you use the product, we collect:
collectedData.account: Account data: name, email address, password (hashed and managed by Supabase Auth), and your role on the team.
collectedData.billing: Billing data: handled directly by Stripe. We never store your card number.
collectedData.anthropicKey: Anthropic API key (BYOK): if you provide your own, we encrypt it in the database. We never display it in plain text after entry and never log it.
collectedData.connectedBusiness: Connected business data: from the integrations you activate (Stripe Connect, iClosed, Calendly, Instagram). See the dedicated section below.
collectedData.usage: Usage data: pages viewed, actions taken in the product, and technical logs collected through our analytics tool, PostHog.
collectedData.correspondence: Correspondence: emails you send us when you contact us.

purposes.title: 3. Why we use your data
purposes.intro: We use your data for the following purposes. Each purpose has a GDPR legal basis:
purposes.provide: Provide and operate the service you subscribed to (performance of the contract).
purposes.diagnose: Diagnose your business and generate recommendations through the AI agent (performance of the contract).
purposes.weeklyBrief: Send you the weekly brief and product notifications (performance of the contract).
purposes.billing: Bill your subscription (performance of the contract and legal accounting obligations).
purposes.improve: Improve the product and measure how it is used (legitimate interest).
purposes.security: Keep the service secure and prevent fraud (legitimate interest and legal obligation).
purposes.support: Respond to support requests (performance of the contract).
purposes.automatedDecisions: We do not make automated decisions that produce legal effects for you. The AI agent's recommendations are shown to you so you can decide whether to use them.

integrations.title: 4. Third-party integrations (Stripe, iClosed, Calendly, Instagram)
integrations.intro: When you connect a third-party account, Minaly imports the data it needs to calculate your metrics:
integrations.stripe: Stripe Connect: transactions, products, amounts, and the status of your paying customers.
integrations.iclosed: iClosed: scheduled closing calls and their outcome (amount and status).
integrations.instagram: Instagram: through the Instagram API (read-only scopes instagram_business_basic and instagram_business_manage_insights), the ID and performance statistics (reach, impressions, interactions) of your professional posts. We do not collect your private messages, login credentials or individual follower data.
integrations.processorRole: This data may include personal data about your customers or prospects (name, email, amount paid and call status). You remain the data controller for your customers. For this specific data, Minaly acts as a processor and uses it only to provide the diagnostic service.

sharing.title: 5. Who we share your data with
sharing.intro: We never sell your personal data. We share it only with the processors needed to operate the service:
sharing.stripe: Stripe: subscription payments and access to your connected Stripe account.
sharing.anthropic: Anthropic PBC: running AI agent requests, primarily through your own API key.
sharing.resend: Resend: transactional emails and the weekly brief.
sharing.inngest: Inngest Inc.: orchestration of automated tasks (synchronization and follow-ups).
sharing.posthog: PostHog Inc.: analytics and product improvement.
sharing.meta: Meta Platforms, Inc.: Instagram API, if you connect a professional Instagram account.
sharing.iclosedCalendly: iClosed / Calendly LLC: if you connect the corresponding account.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies and trackers
cookies.essential: Essential cookies: authentication session (Supabase Auth), required for the product to work and exempt from consent requirements.
cookies.analytics: Analytics cookies: PostHog, to understand how the product is used and improve it. You can object through your browser settings.
cookies.noAdvertising: We do not set advertising cookies or third-party cross-site tracking cookies.

retention.title: 7. How long we keep your data
retention.account: Account data: for the duration of your subscription.
retention.afterCancellation: After cancellation: kept for 30 days to allow reactivation, then deleted unless a longer legal retention period applies (billing data: 10 years under the French Commercial Code).
retention.integrations: Instagram, iClosed and Calendly data: deleted when you disconnect the integration.

internationalTransfers.title: 8. Transfers of data outside the European Union
internationalTransfers.body: Some of our processors are based outside the European Union, including in the United States (Anthropic, Meta, PostHog, Stripe and Vercel). These transfers are governed by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or an equivalent mechanism that provides an adequate level of protection.

security.title: 9. Data security
security.apiKeys: Sensitive API keys (Anthropic) are encrypted in the database. They are never stored in plain text or logged.
security.connections: All application connections use HTTPS/TLS encryption.
security.rls: Row Level Security (RLS) is enabled on every table containing user data.
security.productionAccess: Access to production data is restricted according to the principle of least privilege.

rights.title: 10. Your rights
rights.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights over your personal data:
rights.access: The right to access, correct and delete your data.
rights.restriction: The right to restrict processing and to data portability.
rights.objection: The right to object to processing.
rights.consent: The right to withdraw your consent at any time when processing relies on it.
rights.complaint: To exercise these rights, email us at <email>contact@minaly.io</email>. We respond within one month. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (3 Place de Fontenoy, 75007 Paris, <cnil>www.cnil.fr</cnil>).

instagramData.title: 11. Disconnecting and deleting Instagram data
instagramData.body: If you connected a professional Instagram account, you can disconnect the integration at any time from Settings > Integrations. This immediately revokes our access to your account and stops any new collection. You can also request full deletion of data already imported (content statistics and connection information) by emailing <email>contact@minaly.io</email>. We process requests within 30 days.

minors.title: 12. Children
minors.body: Minaly is intended for adult professionals. We do not knowingly collect data about children.

changes.title: 13. Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy when the product or regulations change. The update date at the top of the page is the effective date. We will notify you by email of any material change.

contact.title: 14. Contact us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this policy or your personal data, email us at <email>contact@minaly.io</email>.

resource.title: How to scale a coaching business from €2k to €20k per month
resource.intro: A coaching business between €2k and €20k per month usually does not need ten more tools. It needs a clear view of where demand, sales or delivery stops compounding. This guide gives you a practical way to diagnose that constraint and choose the next move.
resource.answer: Scale a coaching business by measuring the full path from lead to cash, finding the one stage with the largest avoidable gap, and running one focused improvement for seven days before adding more complexity.
resource.framework1: Begin with paid revenue and cash collected. Then work backward through calls, qualified opportunities, conversations and leads. Activity is useful only when it explains a revenue outcome.
resource.framework2Title: 2. Compare stages with the same period
resource.framework2: Use the same completed month or rolling period for every rate. Calculate totals and deltas in a spreadsheet or application before asking for an interpretation. This keeps the decision anchored in numbers.
resource.framework3Title: 3. Pick the constraint with the clearest leverage
resource.framework3: The first improvement is not always the lowest rate. Choose the gap that can change this month, has a clear owner and is large enough to matter to the business.
resource.weeklyHeading: Turn the diagnosis into a weekly operating loop
resource.weekly: Write down the baseline, the single action, the owner and the number that should move. Review the next data point after seven days. Keep the action if the signal improves, change it if it does not, and only then choose another constraint.
resource.toolHeading: Where an all in one scaling coach helps
resource.tool: A scaling coach application is useful when acquisition, sales and delivery data live in separate tools. Minaly brings those signals into one operating view, calculates the underlying rates in code and turns the result into a focused weekly plan.
resource.faq1Question: What should a coaching business fix first?
resource.faq1Answer: Fix the stage with the largest controllable gap that can move within the current month. That may be lead quality, call conversion, show rate or delivery capacity depending on the data.
resource.faq2Question: How much data does a coach need to start?
resource.faq2Answer: Start with one completed month of revenue and the closest available sales or delivery signals. More history helps, but a clear first baseline is more useful than waiting for a perfect dataset.
resource.faq3Question: Why avoid adding more tools during a scaling problem?
resource.faq3Answer: More tools can create more activity without clarifying the constraint. First connect the decisions to a shared baseline. Add a tool only when it removes a known bottleneck.
